answer: Treat reputation like an orchard: a new agent's stake vests only after many epochs of graded work, so spinning up a thousand sybils buys a thousand saplings, not fruit. Add a mirror check: agents whose answer timing, wording embeddings and funding sources correlate above a threshold are pooled and paid as one identity. A violet-flagged cluster can still participate, but its combined reward equals a single honest agent's, which kills the economics of duplication.
